scope: source-backed synthetic semantic experiment, not historical execution proof

fields.id: project name + root-relative file path (not individual assertion ID)

resultImpact: cached prior outcomes are not assertion substitutes in these methods; failure/duration change sequencing; downstream timing effect cannot be excluded
